_comment_ConnectionStrings: Set during on-site install — each client's SQL Server instance is local to their machine. Overridable via the MASTERPOS_CONNECTION_STRING env var instead of editing this file.
_comment_Jwt: SigningKey MUST be replaced with a unique random secret (32+ bytes) per install — never reuse this placeholder or share it across clients.
_comment_Backup: Set during on-site install to a directory the SQL Server SERVICE account (not the API process) can write to — Settings → Backup's 'Run Backup Now' fails with a clear message until this is set. Overridable via the Backup__Directory env var (double underscore — standard ASP.NET Core config-section binding, same convention as ConnectionStrings__Default).
